name: Vilallonga de Ter (Spain)
description: Yellow field with the light blue open castle of the arms in the upper hoist and two white and blue wavy fesses along the lower part.
history: The official flag of Vilallonga de Ter is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with the light blue open castle of the arms placed over the second, third and fourth horizontal twelfths and the second and third vertical ninths of the cloth, and wavy stripes below; two shades of blue are used, the castle lighter than the waves.

features.role: open castle of the arms in light blue
